entries.heading: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, any amounts
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 16002.  Notwithstanding any other provision of law, any amounts 
appropriated for ``Federal Emergency Management Agency--Disaster Relief 
Fund'' in this Act are available only for the purposes for which they 
were appropriated.
